column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/reset_if_values.onsa tests=12 evaluated=11 unavailable=0 skipped=1 waiting=0
@ a condition that never holds is no condition
@ the condition is a level: every true frame resets, and the frame gives its own input
process 0 frames=8 in r=[false false false true false false true false]
process 1 frames=8 in r=[false true true true false false false false]
@ a rising edge resets once: let pb = prev~(start) and reset_if~(start && !pb)
process 0 frames=8 in s=[false true true true false true true false]
process 1 frames=8 in r=[false true true true false true true false]
@ a condition of the kind block is read at each frame: the frames of a call where it is true all reset, the calls cut where it changes
@ reset_if~(c at (sample / 4)) reads the condition at the grid of sample / 4 only: it resets at the frames 0 and 4 and not at 5
@ the values of the kinds block and init are not put back (the copy of the input and the part computed at block), the state is
process 0 params g=0x40000000 frames=6 in r=[false false false true false false]
@ reset_if~ does not touch the phase counter: sample_tick() goes on
process 0 frames=6 in r=[false true false true true false]
@ a field written at a tick and read at sample is T.default() after the reset until the next tick; the counter goes on
process 0 frames=8 in r=[false false false true false false false false]
process 1 frames=8 in r=[false false false false true false false false]
- x.when~(c).reset_if~(r) resets the stopped frames too and the held output, before the stage that the when moves; x.reset_if~(r).when~(c) resets only the frames that run
@ x.when~(true).reset_if~(r) is not x.reset_if~(r) where the reset is at a tick of a slower stage of x: the reset is before the stage that the when moves (S-1228)
process 0 frames=8 in r=[false false false false true false false false]
process 1 frames=8 in r=[false false false false true false false false]
process 2 params c=true frames=8 in r=[false false false false true false false false]
process 3 params c=true frames=8 in r=[false false false false true false false false]
process 4 frames=8 in r=[false false false true false false false false]
process 5 frames=8 in r=[false false false true false false false false]
process 6 params c=true frames=8 in r=[false false false true false false false false]
@ the grid of a reset_if~ inside a when~ counts the runs of the part, not the frames
process 0 params c=true frames=8 in w=[true true false true false false true true]
@ the calls of process cut the frames anywhere, and a reset in the middle of a grid starts over, with the counter (§13.4, §11.6)
process 0 frames=12 in r=[false false false true false false false false false true false false]
process 1 frames=3 in r=[false true false]
process 1 frames=4 in r=[false false false false]
process 1 frames=3 in r=[true false false]
process 2 frames=3 in r=[false false false]
process 2 frames=12 in r=[false false false true false false false false false true false false]
